text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers keep the original conditions, the `&&` short-circuit order and the `continue`-to-fall-through behaviour, and `BuildPlan` now has a cognitive complexity of roughly 6, well under 15. I couldn't build it here, so the build condition rests on reading the code. The nullable-tuple `is var (a, b)` pattern is valid and definitely assigned, and the `const` placed between methods would only fail if a member-ordering analyzer is enabled.
